# Codex UI Kit (selected vendored components)

Source: https://github.com/JaminZhou/codex-ui-kit
License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 JaminZhou.
Upstream package/source version inspected: 0.1.2.

Copied/adapted from upstream: Button and IconButton, AgentMessage, StatusIndicator, AgentActivity, AgentPlan.
ComposerDock was adapted from the upstream public component layout to avoid importing its unrelated menu and queue dependencies.

Only these independently licensed UI components are included. No OpenAI brand assets, official desktop binaries, fonts or private code are bundled.

StripBot keeps its original business callbacks, editor, execution/approval rules, and theme selection. See `kit-theme.css` for scoped visual tokens.
